checks.text: The page shows the heading "Vigenere Cipher".
Typing "HELLO" in the field labelled "Message" and "KEY" in the field labelled "Key", with the radio button "Encode" selected, shows "RIJVS" in the field labelled "Result".
Typing "RIJVS" in the field labelled "Message" and "KEY" in the field labelled "Key", with the radio button "Decode" selected, shows "HELLO" in the field labelled "Result".
Typing "hello" in the field labelled "Message" and "key" in the field labelled "Key", with the radio button "Encode" selected, shows "rijvs" in the field labelled "Result".
Typing "HELLO WORLD" in the field labelled "Message" and "KEY" in the field labelled "Key", with the radio button "Encode" selected, shows "RIJVS UYVJN" in the field labelled "Result".
Clicking the button "Copy" when the field labelled "Result" contains "RIJVS" changes the button label to "Copied" for 2 seconds, then back to "Copy".

After encoding "HELLO" with key "KEY" to get "RIJVS", clicking the button "Add to history" adds a list item containing "HELLO" and "RIJVS". Clicking the "Delete" button on that item removes it from the list.
Clicking the tab labelled "History" shows the list of previous conversions. After adding one conversion, the list contains one item with the text "HELLO" and "RIJVS".
Reload keeps the history list item containing "HELLO" and "RIJVS" after the page is reloaded.
